uuid.description: Existing record's full ID or unique UUID prefix of at least 6 hex characters, from query/search/get. UUID matching ignores case and hyphens; ambiguous prefixes are refused. Not an agent domain or project name.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned for this same record. Omit or pass null to start at the beginning; an unknown cursor is refused.

limit.description: Positive maximum timestamp groups per page, not lines or bytes. Omit or pass null to read up to the configured body-size ceiling.

include_edit_context.description: True adds full UUID, acting tenant and opaque full-row revision for conflict-safe editing. Compare every page's context before enabling Save.

agent_id.description: Agent domain to filter by. Omit or pass null for all agents plus fleet-shared records; naming an agent excludes fleet-shared records.

record_type.description: Exact memory type: episode, knowledge, identity, reasoning, emotional, user_profile, ras or coding_reasoning. Omit/null for all types.

project.description: Exact project name filter. Omit or pass null for all projects.

include_archived.description: Include archived records when true; deleted records never appear.

uuid.description: Existing record's full ID or unique UUID prefix of at least 6 hex characters, from query/search/get. UUID matching ignores case and hyphens; ambiguous prefixes are refused. Not an agent domain or project name.

old_string.description: Exact body text to replace, including whitespace. Must occur once unless replace_all is true; absent or ambiguous matches are refused.

new_string.description: Replacement body text, verbatim. Use an empty string to remove the match.

replace_all.description: False requires a unique match; true replaces every exact occurrence.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision from get(include_edit_context=true). Supply together with expected_tenant; stale saves are refused without changes.

expected_tenant.description: Acting tenant from the same edit_context, a precondition not a selector. Supply together with expected_revision.

uuid.description: Existing record's full ID or unique UUID prefix of at least 6 hex characters, from query/search/get. UUID matching ignores case and hyphens; ambiguous prefixes are refused. Not an agent domain or project name.

title.description: New nonblank display title; omit/null to keep it. Use clearing to remove it.

tags.description: Replacement tag list; [] empties it. Omit/null to keep existing tags.

project.description: New nonblank project name; omit/null to keep it. Use clearing to remove it.

content_summary.description: New nonblank authored summary; omit/null to keep it. Use clearing to remove it. Maximum 1000 Unicode characters; longer input is rejected, never truncated. Aim for 300-500 characters.

clearing.description: Fields to set to null: title, tags, project and/or content_summary. Omit/null to clear nothing; do not also supply a replacement for a cleared field.

expected_revision.description: Opaque revision from get(include_edit_context=true). Supply together with expected_tenant; stale saves are refused without changes.

expected_tenant.description: Acting tenant from the same edit_context, a precondition not a selector. Supply together with expected_revision.
